rules: A local media brand with Eric at the center. The feed remains useful before someone needs to buy or sell.
Keep the look clean and local. Avoid corporate gloss.
Use After Hours consistently, with the recommended daytime warm base.
Use source-supported towns, streets, businesses, homes and Glastonbury/East of the River locations as visual identity.
Avoid generic Realtor graphics, luxury-for-luxury's-sake styling, heavy sales language and making every post an ad.
